research_object: Context-conditioned evidence for biological or technological activity beyond Earth.
constraints: Separate habitability, candidate signal, candidate confirmation, and sensitivity-limited null result.
Keep abiotic, instrumental, terrestrial interference, and contamination counter-hypotheses explicit.
Do not call any proposed workflow a life detection.
Selected ideas must provide a falsification condition and a discriminating next observation.

recommended_seed.title: A common context and provenance ledger for biosignatures, technosignatures, and in-situ measurements
recommended_seed.mechanism: Map candidate data, environmental context, alternative hypotheses, sensitivity, and follow-up value to bounded evidence statuses.
